title: Farstrand - Herald
message:
FARSTRAND boss theme "Herald".
E minor, 160 BPM. Orders 1-6 loop.
The hook is the HELIOBANE Herald motif; the break quotes the Farstrand title motif.
All samples synthesized. Source: songs/farstrand_boss.gen.js

patterns.name: break: the title motif in glass
A3: the motif doubled in glass
